findings.note: On Oct 18, 2026, Salomonsson came off non-roster injured reserve after shoulder surgery and was sent to AHL Manitoba without playing an NHL game this season. No recall was found, so it is unclear whether he will play tonight.

His 2025-26 NHL line was 1 goal, 4 assists and 5 points in 32 games, averaging 17:57 of ice time with one power-play assist. That is a low scoring rate for a depth defenseman, which fits the Under. ESPN's status fields conflict: this page shows him as OUT while his stats page shows Active.
In camp he was competing with right-handed defensemen Jack St. Ivany and Henry Thrun for a roster spot. If he plays, he is likely in a depth role, and he may be rusty after missing time for surgery.
